# Engineering Manager -Analytics House
Remote Ireland
**Location**Our **Engineering Manager - Analytics House** will be an integral part of our global R&D team. This role is based remotely in the East Coast US, the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. **Who We Are** DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.
**The Opportunity** The Engineering Manager is a hands-on, player-coach leadership role. You are embedded with your team - daily standup, code review, architectural calls, delivery planning, and performance management - and you own both the team's output and the team's growth. This is a genuinely technical & leadership role. You are expected to write and review code, be a credible voice in architectural decisions, and stay current in your team's stack. You lead by demonstrating you can do the work at the highest level, not by title alone. The balance between hands-on contribution and leadership depends on the team's context, but your overarching mandate is the same: run the team, execute and deliver, and grow its impact. Build the bench, raise the standard, and keep the operating cadence sharp as the work and the organization evolve. You work AI-augmented yourself, expect the same from your team, and push the team's craft forward with every new capability that lands. **Responsibilities****Team leadership & growth**
* Leading a team of engineers, owning both its delivery and its development.
* Lead a mindset and process of continuous improvement within the team and meaningfully impact the team’s growth and success over time. Small, compounding improvements, delivered via fast iterations, are the operating rhythm we expect, not an aspiration.
* You are responsible for the professional well-being and career development of team members. Develop engineers through regular 1:1s, growth plans, performance reviews, and direct, candid feedback.
* Develop the next layer of leadership - tech leads, senior engineers ready to manage, and ICs ready to step into staff roles.
**Technical leadership**
* Write code and review code. Be a credible voice in technical decisions because you have hands in the work, not because of your title - you are current, not rusty.
* Drive the team's architectural and technical design decisions in partnership with senior ICs, ensuring alignment on approach and implementation.
* Uphold engineering standards through thorough, constructive pull-request review and a healthy release process, keeping the team's components scalable and in a healthy state.
* Work AI-augmented and lead an AI-augmented team, applying sharp judgment about where AI helps and holding the same quality bar for what ships.
**Roadmap & delivery**
* Own the team's commitments - what was promised, when it was promised, and the quality bar that was held.
* Run a disciplined cadence of planning, prioritization, and delivery without becoming a process bureaucrat.
* Partner closely with the Technical Product Owner and Product team on scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs, maintaining a roadmap that reflects both near-term priorities and longer-term direction.
* Understand the broader business objectives behind the work, translate that context for the team, and ensure engineering effort clearly aligns with those objectives.
* React decisively to change - re-planning, re-prioritizing, and re-staffing as the business moves - while keeping the team engaged and steady through the shift.
**Hiring**
* Own hiring for your team. Interview thoughtfully, decide quickly, and refuse to lower the bar to fill seats.
* Recruit, coach, and - when needed - make hard calls toward the standard the team is held to.
* Operate as a role model for other engineering managers across the organization: share your operating model, mentor peers, and raise the management bench.
**Day-to-day communication & collaboration**
* Upwards: Communicate clearly and succinctly, giving leadership the right level of context and prioritizing escalations based on relevant, well-gathered information.
* Downwards: Empower senior engineers to own key areas of the product, and coach team members to stay focused, intentional, and aware of their impact.
* Sideways: Partner effectively with Product, Design, GTM, Customer Success, and other teams - raising challenges and opportunities constructively to support cross-team alignment.
**Qualifications**
* **10+ years of engineering experience**, including **4+ years in engineering management roles** where you actively coded as part of your responsibilities.
* Hands-on, real-life experience building cloud-based SaaS products - running services in production o**n AWS, GCP, or Azure**, and owning **availability, cost, and the customer-facing surface**.
* API first mindset, products are built not just for end user experience through UI, they are fully functional and available through APIs, so both humans and agents can interact with the platform
* Strong background in **databases, SQL, query optimization, and BigQuery.**
* A track record of taking an engineering team and visibly transforming it - measurable improvements in delivery velocity, technical quality, or team caliber.
* Deep technical fluency in your team's primary stack. You can read, write, and review code at a senior level, and you are current - not rusty.
* Strong opinions on how high-performing engineering teams operate, and a clear philosophy on hiring, coaching, performance management, and technical decision-making.
* Excellent judgment under pressure. You make calls quickly with imperfect information, communicate them clearly, and take responsibility for the outcomes.
* Direct, candid communication. You give hard feedback well, and you hear it well.
**Bonus Points**
* A strong, already-established AI-augmented workflow, with opinions on how to apply AI tools and agentic workflows to raise both velocity and quality.
* Hands-on experience with more than a single cloud provider.
* Background in scaling teams, processes, or technical systems as the organization grows. **Are you a Do’er?**Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference. We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally. What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values. Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page. We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button. Full-time employee benefits include:
* Unlimited Vacation
* Flexible Working Options
* Health Insurance
* Parental Leave
* Employee Stock Option Plan
* Home Office Allowance
* Professional Development Stipend
* Peer Recognition Program
**Many Do’ers, One Team**DoiT unites as *Many Do’ers, One Team*, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

# Lead Business Analyst – Agile Transformation & Complex Program Delivery
We are looking for an experienced Lead Business Analyst to support a complex Agile transformation and large-scale delivery program. This role will lead the analysis, scoping, dependency mapping, and planning readiness activities required to move strategic initiatives from concept through discovery, planning, delivery, release, and operational handover.
The Lead Business Analyst will work across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Operations, Compliance, Integrations, Data, and Delivery teams to ensure that business needs are clearly understood, requirements are structured, dependencies are visible, and teams enter Joint Planning / PI Planning with enough clarity to make realistic delivery commitments.
This role is suited to someone who can operate at both strategic and detailed levels: facilitating senior stakeholder alignment, challenging assumptions, shaping complex scope, and ensuring that analysis outputs translate into clear backlogs, features, acceptance criteria, risks, dependencies, and decision records.
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Scoping & Requirements Leadership**
* Lead the elicitation, analysis, and documentation of business, product, operational, and technical requirements across complex initiatives.
* Translate business objectives and stakeholder needs into clearly structured features, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting analysis artefacts.
* Ensure requirements are aligned to strategic outcomes, OKRs, product goals, operational readiness, and measurable business value.
* Support Product Owners and Product Leads in shaping initiatives into MVPs, releases, and incremental delivery slices.
* Ensure scope is defined clearly enough to support delivery, while remaining flexible enough to adapt as learning emerges during Agile delivery.
**Joint Planning / PI Planning Readiness**
* Lead the analysis work required to prepare initiatives for Joint Planning / PI Planning events.
* Work with Product Owners, Technical Project Managers, Engineering Managers, Scrum Masters, Architects, and team representatives to prepare feature definitions, program backlogs, dependency inputs, risks, assumptions, and planning materials.
* Support the creation of planning boards, dependency maps, confidence-vote inputs, ROAM risk inputs, and initiative-level readiness checklists.
* Ensure teams enter planning with a shared understanding of the problem, scope, constraints, dependencies, and intended outcomes.
* Help identify whether work is suitable for Scrum delivery, Kanban flow, or a hybrid delivery approach.
**Dependency Mapping & Cross-Team Coordination**
* Identify, document, visualise, and maintain cross-team and cross-system dependencies.
* Map dependencies across product teams, platform teams, integration teams, infrastructure teams, operational teams, compliance teams, and data/reporting teams.

* Support Scrum of Scrums / dependency forums by ensuring blockers, risks, and cross-team impacts are clearly articulated and owned.

**Stakeholder Facilitation & Decision Support**

* Champion strong backlog hygiene, Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, dependency transparency, iterative delivery, and outcome-focused planning.

* Support the creation and improvement of Agile analysis standards, templates, and working practices.
* Coach and guide other Business Analysts in Agile requirements practices, story mapping, backlog structuring, and dependency analysis.

* Maintain documentation standards across Jira, Confluence, and visual collaboration tools.
* Ensure analysis outputs are practical, current, and useful to delivery teams rather than static documentation.

* Set clear expectations for documentation quality, analytical structure, stakeholder engagement, and dependency tracking.
* Review key BA deliverables and ensure consistency across the program.
* Help build a stronger Business Analysis capability within the Agile delivery model.

* Strategic Program Leadership:

* Stakeholder Management and Executive Communication:
* Act as the central point of communication for the Technology Resilience program.

## Product Engineer - Frontend
**TL;DR:** a generational AI+Data infrastructure company with a motivated, talent-dense and ambitious team. We’ve grown rapidly over the last 12 months and are hiring for the next phase of growth. Opportunities for high ownership, interesting work, and fast progression.
Orchestra is an AI infrastructure company and we are the creators of Orchestra - the Control Plane for Data and AI. Data teams are overturning how they do their day-to-day. More people than ever want to use AI and Data to automate. But data teams still spend thousands of manual hours manually moving data, integrating tools, and firefighting ad-hoc requests. We’re solving that problem in massive enterprises like Experian and Octopus Energy, and are hiring for the team to scale our growth.
Building the Orchestra platform was the first step, but our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you're excited to solve some of AI’s biggest problems, build a generational company, and do it with an friendly, hard-working, talented, but humble team, then Orchestra is for you.
## Our Culture
Our culture is defined by six key principles.
* High Ownership and Accountability: Turn great ideas into reality and own the outcome. No red tape here, and plenty of tokens.
* Ambition and High Achievement: An exceptionally high bar, held with humility.
* Openness: A flat structure where the best ideas win.
* Transparency: Everyone sees the goals, the plan and the numbers.
* Teamwork: One Orchestra. Autonomous, never independent.
* Trust: Responsibility, flexibility and tools in exchange for high standards.
## Engineering at Orchestra
* We care deeply about our users, their pain points and experience
* We're a small team of generalists who embrace new challenges regularly
* We're united by our mission, focused execution, and speed
* We deploy to production multiple times a day, every change goes through peer code review and automated CI before it ships, and we verify it in a live environment before release
* We run a genuine continuous-improvement loop, not just a slogan: monthly retros, and we actively track our own lead time and deployment frequency, constantly asking whether the way we build could be faster or better
* Tech debt isn't an afterthought, every planning cycle guarantees at least one tech debt item gets worked
## Role Mission
The mission of our Frontend Engineer is simple but critical: give customers a product experience that matches how good the platform is underneath. From the outset, you'll have real ownership over the core frontend, the interfaces our customers use every day to build, monitor and trust their data and AI workflows.
The impact here is immediate, not something you'll wait months to find. You'll have access to the very best tools, work in an AI-native team that is continually pushing boundaries and work alongside an ambitious team of world-class engineers.
## What You'll Accomplish
* Own the core frontend: you'll build, maintain and design the interfaces our customers rely on every day: React and TypeScript, shipped to production multiple times a day
* Ship end-to-end: you'll drive features from idea through to production, not hand off design or QA to someone else
* Work directly with customers: you'll sit close to the people using what you build, not just take a spec and disappear
* Influence product direction: your read on what's clunky, what's missing, and what customers actually need will shape what we build next
* Grow beyond frontend: this isn't a role that keeps you boxed in you'll pick up backend and infrastructure work over time, with the team's support, as your ownership expands
* Help shape how we build: as a small engineering team, you'll have a real say in our culture, our standards, and how we work, not just the code you ship
## Exceptional Candidates Have Demonstrated
* Real depth in React: you haven't just used React, you've hit its edges in production, made real architecture calls, and know why certain patterns exist rather than just following them
* Proven impact through tangible work: whether self-taught or degree-educated, we value a portfolio of shipped projects and an active GitHub presence that demonstrates your ability to build and articulate complex technical solutions. We prioritize what you have created over where you studied.
* A bias to shipping: you know the difference between a fix that takes five minutes and a problem worth pausing on, and you don't gold-plate the former chasing an elegant solution nobody asked for
* Comfort outside the frontend: you've worked in a cloud environment, and ideally you've dabbled in Python or backend work or you're genuinely hungry to learn more
* A hunger to keep growing: frontend is where you're strongest today, not where you plan to stay forever - you want to pick up more of the stack as you go
* A commercial instinct: you understand that what you ship affects real customers, and you've built relationships with the people who use your work, not just shipped into a void
## Compensation & Benefits
* Base Salary: £100k-£120k + Equity
* Team perks: Annual Offsite, bi-weekly socials, monthly team lunches
* Choice of laptop
* Access to latest and greatest AI tooling
* Work from home budget
* Referral bonuses

including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as
analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses
with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to
large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver
measurable results. We also enable Google to engage with customers at scale.

ads.

smoothly together.

websites.

build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE
ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our
externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's
needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an
ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.

building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE
team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale
which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding,
algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of
intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our
organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds,
experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and
take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on
meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides
the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and
maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google
platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our

Ensures all SCM artefacts are audit-ready, compliant with regulatory requirements, and fit for automated downstream consumption, including AI-assisted and generative authoring workflows as these scale across R&D. Standards definition & lifecycle governance

* Experience developing training materials and supporting adoption of new standards or processes.
* Experience leading enterprise-scale content transformation or digital authoring programmes—including structured/component content platforms, reuse strategies, and AI-enabled or generative authoring pilots—in a regulated life sciences environment is a strong advantage.

* Content modelling, taxonomy design, and metadata schema development.
* Standards documentation and governance framework design.
* Regulatory compliance and GxP content requirements.
* Data quality assessment and compliance monitoring.
* Stakeholder engagement and ability to achieve consensus across technical and non-technical audiences.
* Training design and knowledge transfer.
* Organisational change management, particularly for driving adoption of new standards and ways of working across large, cross-functional author and reviewer communities.
* Awareness of AI/GenAI governance considerations for regulated content generation, including human-in-the-loop review and traceability.

UK, Stevenage,
USA, Upper Providence,
Belgium, Wavre
Canada, Mississauga

# Senior Research Investigator (In-vitro Pharmacology), London

Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.
The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery.
Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.
The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you.
### **About Iso**
Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.
Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.
We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.
Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.
### **Your impact**
Isomorphic Labs is seeking an exceptional individual to join an impactful in-vitro pharmacology sub team within our translational science team, working in multidisciplinary ML-based drug discovery medical research.
These roles would be ideal for an experienced in-vitro pharmacologist with significant working knowledge of biophysical, biochemical and/or cell-based functional assays who have extensive experience of providing quantitative in-vitro pharmacology expertise within drug discovery projects.
This is an exciting opportunity to work closely with world leading AI, ML and drug discovery experts to develop imaginative new ways to test biological hypotheses, building a deep mechanistic understanding of drug target interactions to drive our projects forward. You will play a key role in defining the screening cascades for our drug design projects, advancing our oncology, immunology and partnership portfolios from early drug discovery through to candidate selection and ultimately to clinical phase work.
You will have experience of working broadly across drug discovery projects and have the ability to think originally and critically, knowing when to apply innovative ideas, and think with a beginners' approach.
### **What you will do**
* Provide technical expertise and leadership on the utilisation of biophysical assay technologies.
* Design efficient and comprehensive biological screening cascades for a variety of internal and partnered drug discovery programs.
* Partner with CROs to design decision-making experiments and deliver the highest quality biological data to inform the path to the clinic.
* Pioneer innovative ways of working within the biophysical space by assessing and implementing next-gen biophysical approaches and technologies.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Drug Design and Technology teams.
### **Skills and qualifications**
### **Essential:**
* BSc, MSc or PhD in a relevant field of biology.
* Extensive experience in designing and implementing biological screening cascades applied to drug discovery projects, from hit identification through to candidate selection.
* Deep knowledge of experimental biophysical assay technologies and their effective utilisation within screening cascades. Proficiency in SPR (or similar techniques such as GCI or BLI) is essential, while experience with other techniques (ITC, MST, DSF/TSA, ligand/protein NMR, MS, and structural biology methods) is highly advantageous.
* Experience with broader experimental *in vitro* pharmacology, including biochemical and cellular assays.
* Experience managing external CROs to acquire and interpret high-quality biological data in a timely manner.
* Experience in project leadership or leading biology within drug discovery programs, ideally from inception to clinical candidate delivery.
* Dynamic, agile, and flexible professional capable of working across multiple projects, therapeutic areas, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Exceptional communication skills, with a track record of effective collaboration across interdisciplinary teams and key stakeholders from diverse technical backgrounds.
### **Nice to have:**
* Proven track record in project leadership or leading biology strategy within drug discovery programs, ideally from inception to clinical candidate delivery.
* Experience working with Data Science teams to establish systems for the ingestion of biological data.
* Proven track record of contributing to drug discovery projects that have delivered clinical candidates.
* Working knowledge of designing and implementing assays and screening cascades for alternative modalities or chemistries (e.g., peptides or molecular glues).
* General understanding of machine learning modelling applied to biological systems and drug discovery.
* Experience in target identification, validation, and selection approaches.
### **Culture and values**
We are guided by our shared values. It's not about finding people who think and act in the same way. These values help to guide our work and will continue to strengthen it.
**Thoughtful**Thoughtful at Iso is about curiosity, creativity and care. It is about good people doing good, rigorous and future-making science every single day.
**Brave**Brave at Iso is about fearlessness, but it’s also about initiative and integrity. The scale of the challenge demands nothing less.
**Determined**Determined at Iso is the way we pursue our goal. It’s a confidence in our hypothesis, as well as the urgency and agility needed to deliver on it. Because disease won’t wait, so neither should we.
**Together**Together at Iso is about connection, collaboration across fields and catalytic relationships. It’s knowing that transformation is a group project, and remembering that what we’re doing will have a real impact on real people everywhere.
### **Creating an extraordinary company**
We believe that to be successful we need a team with a range of skills and talents. # Senior Product Manager (VCS Ecosystem)
Amsterdam, Netherlands; Belgrade, Serbia; Berlin, Germany; Limassol, Cyprus; London, United Kingdom; Madrid, Spain; Munich, Germany; Paphos, Cyprus; Prague, Czech Republic; Remote, Germany; Warsaw, Poland; Yerevan, Armenia
You know version control is more than just a subsystem. It’s the backbone of how teams build software. You’re ready to shape the future of code-change workflows, from local commits to AI-assisted reviews. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning a core IDE feature into a standalone ecosystem, this is for you.
### **About JetBrains**
We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.
### **What you’ll do**
Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.
As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools. You’ll have the ownership to set a clear product vision that covers everything from complex local merges to remote, containerized, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and quality leads, as well as product marketing, developer advocacy, and the IntelliJ Platform teams. Together, you'll figure out how to handle the next era of software delivery, including tracking provenance and reviewing AI-generated changes across different environments.
Day to day, you will:
* Set the long-term product strategy for VCS and code-change workflows across all JetBrains IDEs.
* Identify gaps in current developer workflows and define new product directions in the VCS space.
* Explore new opportunities, from cross-IDE VCS clients and host-neutral code reviews to AI-native review and authorship tracking.
* Listen closely to what the community and the industry are saying to figure out exactly what we should be working on.
* Align roadmap decisions across the product, engineering, design, marketing, developer advocacy, partnership, and customer-facing teams.
* Work with engineering and quality leads to balance user value, technical constraints, and platform health.
* Shape external positioning and represent our VCS direction in conversations with customers and the broader developer tools community.
### **What you’ll bring**
* A collaborative mindset that works well with engineering and quality teams on deeply technical challenges.
* Strong product judgment, especially when navigating ambiguous areas to define a new ecosystem.
* The ability to think beyond existing boundaries and spot opportunities for entirely new workflows.
* Clear communication skills, whether you’re aligning internal stakeholders or talking to deeply technical users.
* A data-informed approach, combining usage metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.
* An interest in how AI is changing software development, from generated commits to AI-assisted reviews.
* A drive to improve solutions instead of copying what already exists.
### **What you’ll need**
* Previous success leading the product direction and strategy for technically complex developer tools, SCM, CI/CD, or code collaboration software.
* The proven ability to translate intricate developer workflows into clear product roadmaps.
* Experience bringing stakeholders together across product, engineering, marketing, and developer advocacy.
* A deep understanding of version control mechanics, code-change workflows, and how developers actually ship code.
* Based in the EU, ideally Munich, Prague, Amsterdam, Berlin, Belgrade, or remote within the EU, with the ability to travel to JetBrains offices as needed.
* As a plus, familiarity with advanced version control scenarios, such as complex merges, monorepos, and enterprise/self-hosted setups.
### **What success looks like**
Success means moving VCS from a platform subsystem to a clear, strategic ecosystem. You’ll have built a compelling product vision that engineering teams are aligned on and customers are excited about. You won’t just be copying what exists. You’ll be finding entirely new ways to solve code-change workflows, especially as AI becomes a bigger part of development. Ultimately, you’ll earn your team's trust by making sound decisions, keeping projects moving, and leaving the product better than you found it.
### **Why join JetBrains?**
* Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
* Flexible work schedule. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
* Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
* Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
* Relocation support. Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
* Free meals and snacks. Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.
* Health and wellness. On-site gyms or sports club stipends.
* Internal events. Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.
\*Some benefits may vary depending on location.

  • Distributed Storage (Cypress): transactional semantics, tiered storage, erasure coding, replication, and strong reliability expectations.

# Senior Business Development Manager - Engineering Biology
* Full-time

## Company Description
LGC’s National Laboratories deliver a range of expert science functions and services in partnership with the UK Government, business, healthcare, and academia. We manage and operate several national laboratories on behalf of government agencies, such as the UK National Measurement Laboratory (NML), MHRA Laboratories Team and National Reference Laboratories, as well as hosting the unique function of the ‘Government Chemist’.
As home to many world-leading scientists, LGC’s National Laboratories provide a wide range of expert analytical science services and subject matter expertise to a broad spectrum of customers, stakeholders, and global forums. In addition, we undertake contract research and development projects for a range of customers in both the public and private sectors. Our work addresses fundamental and emerging measurement challenges, helping to foster innovation and promoting productivity and economic growth.

Job Purpose
Science underpins the National Measurement Laboratory (NML) business, and growing our business is essential to unlocking its value and supporting future commercial success. This is an outstanding opportunity to lead in the Engineering Biology (EngBio) field, where you can make a real difference by promoting growth and strategic focus for a world-class organization.

Work alongside the Commercial Director and the Commercial and Contract Management team to promote growth and value, initially focusing on the Engineering Biology (EngBio) sector. Lead engagement with interested parties, build credible consortia, manage and attend relevant events, and develop and submit high-quality, strategically aligned, and competitive funding proposals. This role is vital to the effective rollout of our business development strategy.

Collaborator Engagement & Relationship Management

# Customer Service Executive - Collections
Nottingham, United Kingdom
At Liberis, our mission is to empower small and medium-sized businesses by removing finance as a friction to growth, delivering contextual, embedded financial solutions to support merchants at every stage of their business lifecycle.
**The team**
We are the Collections team! A dedicated group with a clear mission: to assist customers facing financial challenges and guide them back to good standing wherever possible. With team members based in the UK, Sweden, Germany and the US, we are looking for an enthusiastic Collections Agent to join our rapidly growing global Collections team and support Liberis' growth in the UK market!
**Who are you?**
As a Collections Agent, you'll take the helm in our in-house collection process, steering a diverse receivables book toward success. Your mission: to maintain impeccable standards of accuracy and timeliness, driving up collection rates while ensuring every customer enjoys a top-notch experience.
**Responsibilities**
* **Conducting daily monitoring** into our receivables book to uncover underperforming and inactive customers, using your sharp analytical skills to identify patterns and opportunities.
* **Solving puzzles:** diving deep in to the why behind customer inactivity, utilising a variety of resources to uncover the most efficient solutions for rehabilitating these customers
* **Direct engagement:** connecting directly with our customers through daily phone calls and emails, bringing energy and enthusiasm to every interactions as you work to reignite their engagement.
* **Legal liaison:** contacting customers we’ve been unable to reach via legal letters, to ensure our message is clear and our approach is effective.
* Take charge in ensuring that defaulting account volumes stay within budget limits by strategising and implementing tactics to minimise the need for accounts to be sent for Debt Collection.
* **Fairness Ambassador:** above all, you’ll champion our commitment to treating customers fairly, ensuring that every action you take reflects the Liberis behaviours and strengthens our customer relationships.
* Thrive in an environment that encourages independent decision-making and have the autonomy to manage and prioritise your daily workload, while always having the support of your team and line managers.
**We think you’ll need**
We're seeking a dynamic individual with a blend of skills and experiences that will make them an invaluable asset to our team:
* Demonstrated experience within a collections team, preferably in SME collections.
* A proven ability to self-manage and prioritise tasks effectively.
* Excellent interpersonal communication skills, enabling seamless interactions with individuals at all levels.
* High level of integrity in all actions and decisions.
* Proficiency in Excel.
* Keen attention to detail to ensure accuracy and precision in all tasks.
* Ability to identify and propose improvements to processes and procedures.
**What happens next?**
Think this sounds like the right next move for you? Or if you’re not completely confident that you fit our exact criteria, apply anyway and we can arrange a call to see if the role is fit for you. Humility is a wonderful thing, and we are interested in hearing about what you can add to Liberis!
**Our hybrid approach**
Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better, and build a great Liberis culture. Our hybrid working policy requires team members to be in the office at least 3 days a week, but ideally 4 days. At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.

* Build and lead the Market Research organization, establishing the operating model, delivery processes, quality standards, and hiring strategy.

Join a Global Market Leader and Build a New Division from the Ground Up
£60,000 - £75,000 + Bonus + Car Allowance
A major global manufacturer of fibre optic and connectivity solutions is looking to appoint an experienced Business Development Manager to establish and grow its Data Centre Fibre business across the UK and Europe.
This is a rare opportunity to take ownership of a brand-new market initiative, with the autonomy to shape strategy, build customer relationships and create a significant revenue stream across one of the fastest-growing sectors in Europe.
The business has a strong international presence, extensive manufacturing capability and a long-standing reputation for delivering fibre optic and communications infrastructure solutions worldwide.
The Role
The Business Development Manager will be responsible for developing the UK and European market for single-mode fibre solutions within the data centre sector.
Working closely with consultants, distributors, contractors and end-users, you'll drive specification, build strategic partnerships and position the business as a preferred supplier for major data centre projects.
Key responsibilities include:
Develop and execute a growth strategy across the UK and Europe.
Drive product specification through M&E Consultants, Data Centre Design Consultants and Engineering Practices.
Build relationships with hyperscalers, colocation providers, end users and key stakeholders within the data centre ecosystem.
Identify, appoint and develop distribution and reseller partners across Europe.
Generate and convert opportunities from early-stage design through to project delivery.
Manage complex sales cycles involving consultants, contractors, distributors and end users.
Deliver market intelligence and help shape the long-term strategy for the division.
Represent the company at industry events, conferences and customer meetings throughout Europe.
About You
We're interested in speaking with candidates who have experience in:
Selling single-mode fibre or fibre optic solutions.
Data centre connectivity and communications infrastructure.
Structured cabling and network infrastructure solutions.
Telecommunications infrastructure products.
Consultant-led specification sales.
You may currently work for a manufacturer, distributor, reseller or systems integrator.
Successful candidates are likely to have:
Experience selling into the data centre market.
A strong network of M&E Consultants, design consultants and engineering firms.
A proven track record of winning specifications and influencing projects at design stage.
Experience developing channel, reseller or distribution networks.
Strong commercial acumen and a genuine new business mindset.
The credibility to engage with both technical and commercial decision makers.
A passion for building markets and creating opportunities where none currently exist.
What's on Offer?
Opportunity to build and lead a new market initiative across the UK and Europe.
Full backing of a major global organisation with significant investment and long-term ambitions in the data centre sector.
High levels of autonomy and visibility within the business.
A genuine chance to shape the direction of a growing division.
Excellent salary, bonus and career progression opportunities.
The Ideal Background
This role would suit an ambitious Business Development Manager who has sold single-mode fibre either through distribution and reseller channels or by driving specification with M&E Consultants and consulting engineers.
If you've successfully developed business within the data centre market and are looking for the opportunity to build something substantial with the support of a global industry leader, we'd love to hear from you.

## Senior Electrochemical Stack Engineer
****About Mission Zero Technologies****
****We’re a London-based climate tech startup working to reinvent carbon for a thriving planet. Since 2020, we have rapidly pioneered the world’s most versatile direct air capture (DAC) technology to recover historic CO2 emissions from the atmosphere, anywhere at any scale. Backed by Breakthrough Energy Ventures, the XPRIZE foundation, Stripe, and the UK Government, we’ve moved a brand new climate technology from lab to commercial plants in under three years to rapidly empower carbon removal and sustainable utilisation.****
## About the role
Join MZT at a pivotal moment as we transition from an early-stage R&D startup to a revenue-generating company ready to scale our direct-air capture technology globally.
We're looking for an Electrochemical Stack Engineer to develop our next generation of stack designs. Electrodialytic approaches to DAC lean on established electrodialysis designs, however these designs are far from optimal for the specificity of electrochemical direct-air capture. As our Electrochemical Stack Engineer you'll lead stack development at MZT. You'll define the opportunity areas for our next-generation stack, develop concepts that attack the biggest resistance losses in the cell, while ensuring stability and robustness, and lead the build–test–evaluate cycles that prove (or kill) them. For winning concepts, you'll scale them into full-size stacks, navigating supply chain and manufacturing constraints along the way.
The role has two sides. You'll lead on the stacks we procure, assessing what the supply chain offers, judging their suitability for our process and specifying modifications where needed. In parallel, you'll lead the development of DAC-optimised electrodialytic stacks designed around our process conditions from the start. On both fronts you'll work closely with our process, mechanical and electrical engineers so that the stack meets the requirements of our DAC technology and the wider plant design.
Reporting to the R&D leadership team, you'll work alongside key members of the R&D lab, and mentor junior scientists and engineers as the team grows.
## What you’ll be doing
* Defining the opportunity areas for MZT's next-generation electrochemical stack: quantifying where the losses sit and which are worth attacking first
* Developing concepts for performance improvement across cell geometry, materials and flow design, backed by models and analysis that clarify your predictions
* Leading build–test–evaluate cycles with the R&D team: designing testing campaigns, characterising stack performance and tracing observed phenomena back to underlying mechanisms and design features
* Scaling successful concepts into full-scale stacks, working through fabrication, assembly and design-for-manufacture constraints
* Leading stack procurement: assessing commercially available stacks, specifying modifications and managing technical relationships with vendors and manufacturers
* Articulating stack requirements to process, mechanical, electrical and safety engineers so the stack and the wider plant design converge
* Closing the feedback loop: internalising learnings from every campaign and applying them to subsequent stack designs
* Mentoring, guiding and supporting junior staff, helping them acquire new skills, knowledge and capabilities
## What you’ll need to be successful in this role
* A deep grounding in the theory and mathematical principles that describe electrochemical processes. You understand electrochemistry from first principles, not just by analogy or heuristics
* Experience designing electrochemical stacks at multiple scales involving aqueous electrolytes, ion-exchange membranes and gas generation
* A strong grasp of how the culmination of geometric features, material selection and process parameters determines the critical performance parameters of a stack
* A track record of taking designs through to fabricated, assembled hardware in collaboration with mechanical, electrical and process engineers
* Significant experience designing and executing testing campaigns, with the diagnostic instinct to trace behaviour back to root mechanisms
* The habit of reducing problems to first principles and building models to sharpen your thinking, paired with the judgement to reach for heuristics when they're the better tool
* Equal appetite for ideation and execution: you can get obsessed with a problem, and you finish what you start
* As comfortable in the lab or workshop as you are developing designs, models and analysis
* Experience mentoring, guiding or supervising junior colleagues
* A degree in chemical engineering, electrochemical engineering, materials science or a related discipline
* Roughly 5–10 years' experience spanning stack design, testing and scale-up
* Clear communication skills across engineering disciplines
## Ideally, you’ll also have:
* Direct experience with electrodialysis, bipolar membranes or related ion-exchange membrane processes
* Hands-on experience with carbonate or alkaline electrolytes, and with managing gas evolution and two-phase flow inside cells
* Electrochemical or multiphysics modelling experience (COMSOL or equivalent, or your own codes)
* Experience with EIS and other advanced electrochemical diagnostics
* Working CAD skills, enough to take your own concepts from sketch to drawing
* Experience working directly with stack, membrane or component manufacturers, and navigating their manufacturing constraints
* A PhD in electrochemistry, electrochemical engineering or a related field
* Experience in a startup or similarly fast-moving R&D environment
* Patents or publications in electrochemical cell or stack design
* Most importantly, we'd also welcome hearing from you even if you feel you are under or overqualified - as finding the right person is critical.

# Senior Data Scientist
## As a Senior Data Scientist you will take deep, structured/tabular problems – rent arrears, tenant risk, contact strategy, repairs history – and work them through to clear, evidence-based outcomes.
**Senior Data Scientist**
**Who we are:**
Founded in 2003, Mobysoft provides data-based insight solutions to a wide range of social housing clients, through market-leading products, simultaneously helping keep tenants housed in homes they can enjoy and improving social housing landlords long term organisational health.
Our vision is a world in which intelligent technology significantly improves the quality of life for people who live in social housing and our mission is delivering accurate actionable data insights that help social housing providers ensure a consistent, equitable service.
**What are we looking for?**
We are an ambitious, customer-centric, hybrid-working Data & Analytics team, dedicated to developing a new generation of data products that unlock significant value for the social housing sector. We operate with a focused product lens, driven by curiosity and a commitment to technical excellence.
As a Senior Data Scientist you will take deep, structured/tabular problems – rent arrears, tenant risk, contact strategy, repairs history – and work them through to clear, evidence-based outcomes.
Alongside our existing senior data scientist (who leads on natural language processing [NLP] / and neural networks [NN]) you will be part of a small, central function that partners closely with product and engineering teams on a single, shared roadmap, with a one-team mentality throughout.
We take a test-and-learn approach: real experiments, time-boxed and honestly evaluated, each ending in a clear call to do more, ship what we have, or stop. We’re looking for an accomplished data scientist with strong foundations, deep structured-data experience, and the judgement to apply the right level of complexity – from simple, robust baselines to more advanced methods where they add clear value.
**Key Responsibilities**
**What will you be doing?**
Our direction of travel includes:
· **Early-warning and lifecycle modelling.** For rent, distinguishing genuine tenant arrears from technical or timing artefacts, and tracking cases from early warning signs through to resolution, stabilisation, or support; for properties, detecting risks, and understanding the balance between planned and responsive repairs.
· **Forecasting.** Forecasting rent payment patterns, balances, and repairs/asset needs over time – for example which property cohorts to prioritise for planned repairs – using both classical and modern time-series methods.
· **Contact strategy.** Designing contact strategies that focus limited capacity on where it can make the most difference across channels including human, AI-assisted, and SMS.
· **Prescriptive analytics.** Linking model outputs to prescriptive, next-best-action recommendations. For example, root cause analysis to help get first-time fixes right on repairs.
· **AI agents.** Designing, building, and deploying AI agents that combine our own data with external reference sources to support faster, better decisions.
· **Deployment & monitoring.** Deploying and monitoring machine learning (ML) models in production, with the engineering discipline to catch drift and issues early.
· **Cross-team support.** Occasional collaboration on NLP/NN-related work led by our existing senior data scientist, providing cover when needed.
· **What's next.** Plenty that hasn't been thought of yet. This list will evolve alongside our business, the role and your findings, insights and ideas.
In short, there will be lots to keep you interested, opportunities to keep your technical and interpersonal skills developing, and a real chance to drive innovation and change.
This is a professional, technical role with no line management responsibilities. There will be multiple opportunities to take technical ownership of, and lead the delivery of, specific data science workstreams.
**Qualifications and skills**
**Required**
**What qualifications and experience are we after?**
· A Master's or PhD in Data Science, ML, AI, or a related quantitative discipline – or equivalent demonstrated commercial experience.
· 5+ years of serious commercial experience across complex problems, including transactional/event-level data, with multiple live solution deployments.
· Experience working in a test-and-learn way as part of a central data team collaborating closely with multiple product and engineering teams against a shared roadmap.
· A track record of committing to and delivering against time-boxed checkpoints, producing concrete, shippable outputs on a schedule.
**What technical skills are required?**
**Data Engineering**
Wrangling and engineering data across our warehouse:
Ability to source, validate, and shape data – including feature engineering and external/open data – grounded in a desire to genuinely understand the data-generating processes and domain context.
Comfortable working across common data formats (e.g. CSV, JSON, Parquet) – loading, inspecting, joining, and aggregating as needed – and understanding what it means for the work when data is slowly changing versus arriving in near real time.
**Coding**
· Strong Python and SQL.
**AI Agents**
· Ability to design and build AI agents that augment the data science process. For example, an agent that cross-references external reference data against our internal records to distinguish a genuine anomaly from a data artefact.
**Core Statistical & ML Toolkit**
· Using gradient boosting (e.g. XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) as the default for tabular prediction.
· Recognising when simpler, more interpretable models, such as regularised logistic regression or well-constrained decision trees, are the better choice.
· Applying clustering and segmentation techniques (e.g. k-means, hierarchical or sequence-based clustering) to characterise populations.
**Model Craft**
· Strong feature engineering skills – turning business context and raw structured data into meaningful, stable and explainable model features.
· Testing whether a model generalises across different populations or datasets, and re-validating or re-tuning it when it's applied somewhere new.
· Designing experiments so they're free of leakage.
· Able to recognise when data limitations, rather than modelling technique, are the constraint.
· Properly handling imbalanced data.
· Calibrating predicted probabilities so they can be understood by domain experts.
**Modelling Change Over Time**
· Time-to-event and state-transition approaches (e.g. discrete-time classification, roll-rate models) for lifecycle and hazard problems.
· Forecasting using classical statistical methods, Bayesian/state-space approaches, and modern pretrained time-series foundation models.
**Connecting Models to Real Decisions**
· Framing problems like contact-list generation as ranking/resource-allocation – focusing limited contact capacity where it's likely to make the most difference.
· Using causal inference and experiment design (e.g. A/B testing) to draw reliable conclusions from real-world, non-experimental data.
**Engineering Discipline**
· Applying solid software engineering practice to ML models – testing, version control, reproducible environments, and production-ready code.
· Delivering work in a time-boxed, iterative way.
**Explainability & Fairness**
· Considering fairness end-to-end – from data, feature and model choices through to testing the resulting model for bias across population groups.
**Desirable**
· A background in another regulated or asset-heavy sector – for example financial services, insurance, utilities, or the public sector – that transfers well to this problem space.
· General familiarity with neural network architectures and NLP/large language model (LLM) tooling, sufficient to pick up key aspects of a teammate's deep-learning codebase with relative ease and do basic fault-finding when needed – this role is structured-data-first, but should be able to provide occasional cover on the team's NLP/NN work.
· Experience working with cloud infrastructure (ideally Amazon Web Services [AWS]) for data storage, training, and deployment.
**The Person**

Our resourcing team are on hand to help with any questions about your application and you can reach them by e-mailing resourcing@morrisonsplc.co.uk.
* 1
### Find an opportunity that's right for you
Once you've found a role that's right for you, you can apply via this site. If it's your first time applying with us then we'll need all your essential information and we might ask you to upload your most recent CV. If you've applied for roles with us before then we should recognise you and you won't need to share these details again, unless something has changed that you need to update us on.
* 2
### Let's find out more
For some of our stores and site roles, if you've been successful with your application we might just e-mail and ask you to book a slot for your interview. For other roles our resourcing team will get in touch with you to find out a bit more about you and why you applied. They'll also answer any questions you might have about us and the role. After all, it's a two way process!
* 3
### Interview
Our interviews are typically face to face but can sometimes be virtual. Don't worry, we'll advise either way. Your interview can differ depending on the role or team. Part of the interview may include some competency questions against our Ways of Working (listed below).
* 4
### Final Stage
With some of our roles there might be a second interveiw. This tends to be for roles in our Head Office and some salaried positions across our stores and sites. As part of this second stage, we might ask you to complete a task, such as a SWOT analysis or something similar, and present it back during the interview. This helps us understand your approach and thinking about the role.
* 5
### Decision
Our resourcing team or the store or site you've applied to will be in touch with you as soon as they can to let you know the outcome. If you've been successful we'll share the details of our offer with you and follow up with everything you need on e-mail.
## Ways of Working
Our Ways of Working are like a set of values that define our core beliefs, guide decision-making, and shape our culture and how we operate.
**Customer First** - I care about our customers and do everything I can to meet their needs
**Teamwork** - I always play my part in the team, and I recognise we go further together
**Working Freely in a Framework** - I’m trusted to make my own decisions and encouraged to improve things for customers and for us
**Care and Respect** - We care more and try harder; for each other, for everyone around Morrisons
**Listen and Respond** - I take the time to talk with and listen to colleagues and customers, and always do the right thing for the them
**Grow Sales, Low Cost** - I understand my part in the end-to-end process and look for ways to drive improvement

We’re a Yorkshire based food manufacturer and retailer, and our story began with a simple market stall in Bradford all the way back in 1899. Today, we’re still just as committed to delivering on our promise of 'freshness from farm to fork' for every customer. It’s why we’ve grown to become one of the UK’s leading supermarkets. And, with 90,000 colleagues, nearly 500 stores, and 11 million customers every week, there are now more reasons to join us than you can imagine.

# HR Director Matt Duck Appointed to the Munnelly Group's Board
HR Director Matt Duck Appointed to the Munnelly Group's Board
The Munnelly Group is pleased to announce the appointment of Matt Duck to the position of Group Board Director - People & Culture, in a move which will see him lead the company's People and Culture function across all eight of its brands.
An experienced HR professional, Matt has worked in senior leadership roles for the last 25 years and will play an integral role in strengthening the Munnelly Group's people and culture function even further, with part of his remit being to embed the 'One Group, One Mission, One Standard' value across the Group.
Having initially joined the company in a consultancy role, Matt was officially named Group Director of HR on a full-time basis in 2023. During his time in this role, he has developed a high-performing HR team and was responsible for relaunching the reward and recognition strategy, enhancing the management of employee relations streams and delivering a suite of leadership workshops.
Matt, who has experience working across numerous sectors, including construction, retail and financial services, before joining the Munnelly Group, will now oversee HR operations at the Group's eight specialist trading businesses - Munnelly Support Services, Guardior, MacRail, Bishopsgate Group, City Calling, Weston Analytics, Bridgehead Consultancy and Severn Partnership.
Taking 'People and Culture' out of the standard HR function and giving it a specific Board directive is a strategic move from the Munnelly Group as part of its long-term growth framework, 'Target 2030'.
**Paul David Munnelly, CEO of the Munnelly Group, said:** *"This appointment to the Munnelly Group Board reflects the high level of importance that we have placed on our People and Culture functions across the Group as part of our long-term, strategic planning process. This new role with a specific Board directive will enable us to drive forward with confidence as we continue to grow the business through investment in our people and exemplary culture to promote our core values of trust, collaboration and innovation.*
*"The success of the Munnelly Group, past, present and future, is built on the foundations of talented and dedicated employees. Each of the different companies within the group provides rewarding and challenging career opportunities for the right people, and, as a whole, we believe that our colleagues are set at the heart of everything we do and all that we achieve. This people-centric approach means that we continue to attract and retain the best employees, which supports our ambition to offer exceptional service to all our customers in the UK construction and infrastructure support services sector."*
**Commenting on his appointment to the Munnelly Group Board, Matt added:** *"I am extremely honoured and delighted to be the new Group Board Director - People & Culture. This is a pivotal time for everyone connected with the business as the people and culture function prepares to deliver a journey of growth across the Group. My aim is to build on the work that has already been put in place and to continue to make Munnelly Group a proud, people-focused organisation, where further enhanced leadership capabilities are developed to bring out the best in every employee here so that we can all achieve, together."*

Our Governance, Risk and Compliance Team are looking for a Senior Cyber Security Analyst to play a key role in protecting critical business services through effective cyber risk management. You’ll bring proven experience in identifying, evaluating and managing risks using established cyber risk management frameworks, alongside a strong understanding of the methodologies and governance approaches used to assess, prioritise and mitigate cyber threats.
Working with a diverse range of stakeholders, you’ll provide expert guidance, challenge assumptions, and help embed a risk-based approach to cyber security across the organisation.

* Develop and maintain the risk assessment framework and risk register, to support risk assessment activities across the organisation.
* Collaborate with business units to identify and design changes and improvements, to address their security needs and promote compliance and capability development.
* Conduct assurance and measurement processes for organisational security capabilities, to produce insightful reports and guide remedial actions across relevant business areas.
* Plan and execute security improvement initiatives across business areas, to ensure consistent delivery and alignment with organisational security objectives.
* Provide technical guidance, support development to other members of the team, to ensure consistency in security practices.
* Monitor developments in security frameworks, regulation, and legislation, to advise on their implications and influence improvements to NATS' security processes.

* Degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security / related field (or equivalent experience).
* CISMP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or equivalent professional certification or experience.
* Demonstrated experience in delivering initiatives which develop capability and promote compliance with security obligations.
* Experience in evaluating complex security challenges across technical, process, and business domains, applying sound judgement to deliver pragmatic and effective solutions.
* Experience identifying, developing and implementing, risk mitigation plans, policies, processes and technical controls.

## Summary
### **The Role**
We're looking for a **Strategic Accounts Payable Data Analyst** to join our Head Office team in Enderby on a permanent basis.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys analysing complex data, uncovering the root causes of issues, and using insight to improve financial performance and operational efficiency. Working closely with the wider Finance team, you'll play a key role in enhancing our Accounts Payable processes, reducing risk, and delivering measurable value to the business.
**You will be required in the office in Leicestershire, 5 days a week**
### **What You Will Take On**
As our Strategic Accounts Payable Data Analyst, you will:
* **Turn data into actionable insight** by using Power BI and Microsoft Excel to analyse invoice ingestion channels, monitor straight-through processing rates, and provide meaningful reporting that supports effective resource planning.
* **Protect financial accuracy** by identifying duplicate invoices, VAT discrepancies, and other exceptions before payment runs, while developing risk-based statement reconciliation processes to strengthen financial controls.
* **Drive efficiency and cash flow performance** by tracking early settlement discounts, analysing Days Payable Outstanding (DPO), and identifying opportunities to optimise working capital while maintaining strong supplier relationships.
* **Identify opportunities for improvement** by investigating the root causes of process issues and recommending practical, data-driven solutions that reduce manual intervention and improve end-to-end performance.
* **Collaborate with stakeholders** across Finance, Procurement, IT and external suppliers, presenting clear insights and influencing positive change through evidence-based recommendations.
### **What You Will Bring**
You'll be a naturally curious and analytical problem solver who enjoys working with data and translating it into meaningful business improvements. You'll also have:
* Advanced skills in **Power BI** and **Microsoft Excel**, with the ability to interrogate, manipulate and interpret large datasets.
* A strong understanding of the **Procure-to-Pay (P2P)** process and how upstream data quality impacts downstream operational performance.
* A proactive approach to identifying root causes, challenging existing processes, and driving continuous improvement.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to present findings and influence decision-making across departments and with external suppliers.
* Strong attention to detail, with a focus on maintaining financial accuracy and mitigating risk.

# Talent Acquisition Associate (Contract)
## Shape how the world's biggest infrastructure gets built — HS2, Heathrow, Sizewell C and more, where the decisions your product informs are measured in years and billions.†
# **Talent Acquisition Associate (Contractor)**
**People · London · Hybrid**
## **Accelerate the growth of our team — hiring the people who forecast risk on HS2, Heathrow and Sizewell C.**
---
### **If you're early in your career and want a job that’s aligned with your exceptional achievements, not your tenure, join nPlan...**
**Own the whole thing. Five to seven live searches, brief to accepted offer. No coordinator beneath you, nobody above you doing the interesting parts. We're a company of around fifty people, so one hire visibly moves it.**
**Hunt for people who don't answer job ads. ML researchers, product people who can hold their own with programme directors, enterprise sellers who sell into infrastructure. Small pools, no inbound shortcut. This is most of the job.**
**Work like a talent team of five, as one person. We’re an AI company, so obviously we know what AI can do. We'll give you the AI tooling and the time to learn it properly. What we need is someone who'll actually run with it.**
**We’re looking for the person who’s blowing the roof off the expectations of what good looks like at your level and wants to take real ownership and accelerate their growth.**
**This is a contractor role that has the potential to grow into more. nPlan is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for exceptional talent that can help us create a step-change in the growth of our business.**
---
#### **Ready to reshape one of the world's largest industries?**
**nPlan has built a unique AI platform that turns the data behind major construction projects into decisions their leaders can act on — forecasting delay and cost risk on some of the world's most important infrastructure, and helping the people running those projects decide what to do about it. Behind that is a machine learning capability that forecasts project risk more accurately than anything else on the market, trained on one of the largest datasets of construction schedules in existence, and built by a world-class engineering and research team recognised as a MacRobert Prize finalist, the UK's top engineering award.**
**Every hire you make goes into that team.**
---
#### **The role — please make sure this excites and energizes you**
**We don't have a talent team. We have this role, and the hiring managers you'll partner with.**
**That's a wider remit than someone a few years in usually gets. That’s because we'd rather back one person who is hungry and learning fast, with real ownership and real support, than hire someone senior to do a fraction of what they're capable of. The bet only works if you close the gap quickly, so we've been specific below about where we'll carry you and where we won't.**
**One important thing: If you’re not comfortable picking up the phone, please don’t apply.**
**You’ll have three main focus areas:**
**Sourcing is the engine, not the fallback. We hire for competencies that are genuinely scarce, and passive channels don't fill those roles. You'll run active, targeted outbound as the default, with the structure to keep five to seven searches alive at once without any of them going quiet for a fortnight. This is the part we expect you to already be good at.**
**We want recruiting here to be data-driven. We've started building the infrastructure, and now need you to use it and help us improve** **it.You** **will be asked to keep the data honest, know your own numbers cold, and change what you're doing when they tell you to. We'd rather you kill a sourcing channel with evidence and move on to the next one than defend one with anecdote.**
**AI is how one person covers this much ground. We’re an AI company, so obviously we know what AI can do. We don't expect you to arrive with a built-out AI workflow but we do expect someone who teaches themselves quickly and is truly curious. You'll get proper onboarding on the tooling, a budget for more, and roughly a quarter to get fluent. After that it's the difference between coping and being genuinely good at this.**
---
#### **What you'll do**
* **Source actively, every day. Build target lists and market maps, find people who aren't looking, and write outreach that gets replies from people who ignore twelve InMails a week. Pick up the phone — our experience tells us this is still the most effective way to source and accelerate time to fill in our talent pools.**
* **Run five to seven searches end to end. Intake, market map, outbound, screen, coordination, offer, close. You'll know where every search stands without having to look it up.**
* **Help us close. Our preferred candidates are in demand and will have counter-offers and multiple processes moving at speed. Getting someone across the line when they have options is a team effort, and you’ll help us make sure they’re excited and we’re prepared.**
* **Keep the numbers honest and use them. Log properly, know your key metrics, understand and own what’s happening in each role you’re working, and bring data to our weekly one-to-one with a view on what you're changing.**
* **Get fluent with the AI stack. Research, list-building, enrichment, drafting and personalising outreach, structuring screens, pulling your own reporting. We'll teach you the first version; we expect you to build on it and make it better.**
* **Learn the domains properly. Machine learning, product, enterprise sales into infrastructure. You don't need to arrive knowing any of this. You do need to reach the point where an ML engineer or construction industry insider takes your call seriously. That means immersing yourself with our team, our products, our industry, and our clients.**
* **Work closely with hiring managers. Run real intake conversations, keep them moving, and get comfortable telling them when the brief and the market don't agree.**
* **Please mention the word 'crane' in your application.**
---
#### **What we're looking for**
* **Around two years of hands-on recruiting where you found your own candidates — outbound, headhunting, referrals, networks — rather than working a queue of inbound applicants. Agency, in-house, embedded or RPO; we care about what you did, not where you did it.**
* **You teach yourself things. Tell us about something you learned on your own initiative and what you did with it. This matters more to us than what you already know, because the tooling and the domains here will move faster than any of us can keep up with.**
* **Ambition in the specific sense we mean it: reaching past the brief. The person who researches a market unprompted, who asks why we're hiring the role at all, who comes back with the candidate nobody asked for. Not longer hours - that’s a meaningless (and often negative) metric.**
* **Placements you can actually evidence. How many people you put into roles, into what, over what period, and roughly what your outreach reply rate looks like. We'll ask, and we'd rather have a modest honest number than a large vague one.**
* **You've carried a heavy concurrent load and can describe the system that made it possible — the actual mechanics, not "I'm organised."**
* **Experience recruiting in technology, data, or adjacent fields, for mid-career and experienced professionals rather than graduate or early careers programmes.**
* **You're comfortable with numbers — conversion rates, funnel maths, honest reporting on your own performance.**
* **You write well. Outreach, candidate updates, hiring manager summaries. Writing is most of this job.**
* **You can set your own pace. Nobody here will be setting your daily targets. We'll give you cadence and support, but the discipline has to come from you. Some people find that liberating and some find it disorienting — be honest with yourself about which you are.**
---
#### **Nice to have**
* **You already use AI tools in your workflow and can show us how.**
* **Exposure to hiring machine learning, data science, or enterprise sales talent.**
* **Recruiting into the UK, US, or Australian markets.**
* **Working knowledge of an ATS beyond submitting into it.**
* **Something you've built or automated in a recruiting workflow — a scoring rubric, a sourcing agent, a report nobody asked for.**
* **Some interest in construction, infrastructure, or AI. You'll be selling this company to sceptical people; caring about it helps.**
---
#### **What working at nPlan will be like**
**We are still a relatively small team, so there is plenty of opportunity for a high degree of ownership and growth, and you will be directly exposed to all areas of the business. This role sits close to the leadership team from day one.**
**This is a contractor role that has the potential to grow into more. nPlan is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for exceptional talent that can help us accelerate the trajectory of our business.**
* **🏄 Generous paid holiday, because time with the people and things you care about matters.**
* **🕐 Flexible working hours, with the team in the Shoreditch office regularly enough to build real relationships, plus quarterly company get-togethers.**
* **🥯 Regular lunches, socials and opportunities to connect as a team.**
* **A Learning & Development budget, strong Health & Wellbeing support, and generous family leave.**
* **Your voice will always be heard. What you do or say counts, not who you are or where you're from. We are a cross-disciplinary team, and come from all backgrounds and cultures.**
* **We have three core values that underlie everything we do:**
+ **Learn from Everything**
+ **Be Radically Truthful**
+ **Aim High, Run Fast**
**We are working hard to create a workplace that is inclusive to everyone, no matter their background, or where they are in life. We believe that only a truly diverse place can create great products that serve a wide audience and improve the world.**
**We believe in equality of opportunities and that's why we make sure that these ideas are reflected in our values, and that we really apply these in all aspects of our company culture.**
**If you have a need for any adjustments during our interview process, let us know and we will do our best to accommodate them.**
---
#### **Hiring process**
* **Intro call (15 min)**
* **Skill set interview (30 min)**
* **Practical exercise (60 min): we'll hand you a real search of ours that has stalled, and ask what you'd do about it. No template, no expected format — we'll send the details 48 hours beforehand. We're interested in how you think, not in what you already know about our industry.**
* **Values Alignment call (60 min)**
* **On-site (half a day, can be remote)**
**If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!**
